title: EDR_T1 intake QC — excluded images (corrupt source TIFFs)
decision: EXCLUDE via run_pipeline.py --exclude-images; do NOT repair.
reason: Corrupt LZW encoded strips in the source USGS P1WHKTRD release (not our copy). Confirmed unrecoverable by BOTH libtiff (Metashape: 'Using code not yet in table' -> OSError Can't load image) and GDAL (gdal_translate: 'Using code not yet in table' -> TIFFReadEncodedStrip() failed at strip offset 8/16). addPhotos reads headers OK but analyzeImages/matchPhotos crash on decode. 2 of 2424 = 0.08%, covered by heavy reef overlap. Flagged in docs/04 (Chat-4 contact-sheet LZW failures); this is the Chat-5 verify-before-dense catch.
